title: CSV quality report
description: A small authoring example that turns a CSV source into a verified quality report.
task: Produce an independently verifiable data-quality report for one CSV source.
success_contract: The report schema is valid and every reported measure is reproducible from the identified source bytes.
invariants: Every derived value retains the source digest and transformation lineage.

stages.title: Ingest
stages.description: Load and validate the source contract.

slots.purpose: Load one explicitly authorized CSV source.
slots.success_contract: The exact source bytes, digest, encoding, and parse configuration are recorded.

slots.purpose: Validate headers, row shape, and declared field types.
slots.success_contract: Every row is classified as schema-valid or retained with a stable rejection reason.

slots.purpose: Measure completeness, uniqueness, validity, and distributions by column.
slots.success_contract: Each measure declares its denominator, treatment of missing values, and source population.

slots.purpose: Render the measurements into the requested report schema.
slots.success_contract: The report validates and contains no unsupported claim or untraceable number.
